lines.en: Would you like to respond?
lines.zh: 要回复吗?

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 想说点什么?

lines.en: : Sorry to be the bearer of bad news but...no.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉要带来坏消息……不。

lines.en: : That could have been the easiest lie of your life nope fuck Imani I guess.
lines.zh: : 那本可以是你人生中最轻松的一个谎。不。操。我想我只好认了,Imani。

lines.en: : Do you really care that much?
lines.zh: : 你真这么在意吗?

lines.en: : OBVIOUSLY. Do you think I'd be a student for Halloween if I was comfortable with how quickly I am DYING?
lines.zh: : 显然。要是我能坦然面对自己 DYING 的速度,我会在万圣节扮成学生吗?

lines.en: : One thousand yen says I'm dying faster.
lines.zh: : 一千日元赌我死得更快。

lines.en: : That does not make my impending death any better!
lines.zh: : 这丝毫没有让我迫近的死期更好受!

lines.en: : In fact, it makes it worse because you were going to be the one to give my eulogy!
lines.zh: : 事实上更糟了,因为本来要念我悼词的人是你!

lines.en: : Why me?
lines.zh: : 为什么是我?

lines.en: : Because Rika is an idiot, Wakana is too gloomy, and Osako is too busy fawning over how gloomy Wakana is.
lines.zh: : 因为 Rika 是个白痴,Wakana 太阴郁,而 Osako 正忙着对着「阴郁的 Wakana」大献殷勤。

lines.en: : Have Kirin do it.
lines.zh: : 让 Kirin 来念。

lines.en: : Kirin would straight crawl into my coffin and fuck my dead body.
lines.zh: : Kirin 会直接爬进我的棺材,上我的尸体。

lines.en: : And I wouldn't?
lines.zh: : 那我就不会?

lines.en: : O_o
lines.zh: : O_o

lines.en: : You know maybe I'll just pre-record my own eulogy and have somebody play the tape.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,也许我干脆提前录好自己的悼词,找个人放录音。

lines.en: : Where'd you even get that uniform?
lines.zh: : 你这套制服到底哪来的?

lines.en: : Custom ordered BIATCH.
lines.zh: : 定制下单的,姐们儿!

lines.en: : I thought the school refused to let you get one.
lines.zh: : 我记得学校拒绝给你配制服。

lines.en: : I may have fabricated an application for a new uniform on behalf of a certain delinquent.
lines.zh: : 我也许以某个不良少女的名义,伪造了一份新制服申请。

lines.en: : Imani...
lines.zh: : Imani……

lines.en: : WHAT she wasn't going to submit one and this was my only chance!
lines.zh: : 怎么了嘛!她又不会自己交申请,这是我唯一的机会!

lines.en: : You could have just gotten one with different colors.
lines.zh: : 你完全可以弄一件颜色不同的。

lines.en: : But then I wouldn't fit in and the girls wouldn't acknowledge me as one of their own!
lines.zh: : 那我就融不进去了,女孩们也不会承认我是她们的一员!

lines.en: : They acknowledge Yasu and her colors are black and white.
lines.zh: : 她们承认 Yasu,而她的配色是黑白。

lines.en: : Okay, but, let's be real. Do they REALLY acknowledge Yasu??? Or do they just let her exist
lines.zh: : 好吧,但现实点。她们真的「承认」Yasu 吗???还是只是放任她存在

lines.en: : Sounds like a form of acknowledgement to me.
lines.zh: : 听起来也算一种承认。

lines.en: : Say, when are you going to get a cool new uniform? I want to see you in our colors.
lines.zh: : 话说,你什么时候弄一身帅气的制服?我想看你穿我们的颜色。

lines.en: : I think you could pull it off. And I'm not just saying that because I've got a thing for dudes in uniforms.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你撑得起来。我不只是因为喜欢穿制服的男人才这么说。

lines.en: : Which I do just FYI.
lines.zh: : 顺带一提,我确实喜欢。

lines.en: : Same.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: : Bro you gay???
lines.zh: : 哥,你是弯的???

lines.en: : Sorry, I meant girls in uniform.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,我是说穿制服的女孩。

lines.en: : Awww Senpai :D
lines.zh: : 哎呀,Senpai :D

lines.en: : Sorry, I meant girls in uniforms they did not acquire via dubious means.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,我是说穿制服的女孩——制服来源得正当。

lines.en: : Awww Senpai D:
lines.zh: : 哎呀,Senpai D:

lines.en: : Imani, you're like 20.
lines.zh: : Imani,你都二十岁左右了。

lines.en: : I'm older than 20 but even THAT is too old! I want to be 15 again!
lines.zh: : 我二十好几了,但连那都太老!我想重新变回 15 岁!

lines.en: : Why in the world would anyone ever want that?
lines.zh: : 世上怎么会有人想要那种事?

lines.en: : Because being an adult fucking SUCKS man we've gotta pay taxes and sign our name on a bunch of shit.
lines.zh: : 因为成年他妈的烂透了,老兄,我们得交税,还得在一堆破事上签名。

lines.en: : If I was 15, all I'd have to sign my name on would be tests. Tests that I'd get an A on since you'd be my teacher.
lines.zh: : 我要是 15 岁,需要签名的就只有试卷。还是你会给我打 A 的试卷。

lines.en: : How come you get to revert to a younger age but I have to stay the same?
lines.zh: : 为什么你能变回更小的年纪,我却必须保持原样?

lines.en: : Hey if you can figure out a way to get both of us back to 15 I will gladly resume this friendship in our smaller forms.
lines.zh: : 嘿,你要是能想出办法让我们俩都变回 15 岁,我很乐意以更小的形态重启这段友情。

lines.en: : But if just one of us is going back, I call shotgun.
lines.zh: : 但要是只能回去一个,那我先占。

lines.en: : But don't worry, we can still chill. I'm sure YOU wouldn't mind.
lines.zh: : 不过别担心,我们照样能一起玩。我确信「你」不会介意。

lines.en: : Ha.
: All seriousness though, I wonder if we would have been friends if we went to school together.
lines.zh: : 不过说正经的,我在想,要是我们一起上过学,我们会成为朋友吗。

lines.en: : Guessing you'd be the gloomy kid sitting in the back of the classroom.
lines.zh: : 我猜你会是那个坐在教室后排的阴郁小孩。

lines.en: : Omg which would mean I would be the super popular girl who starts hanging out with you despite everyone being like UHHH IMANI WHY HE IS WEIRD
lines.zh: : 天哪,那就是说,我会是那个超受欢迎的女孩——不顾所有人「呃啊 IMANI 他好怪」的反对,开始和你厮混

lines.en: : And then you'd be all like I HAVE A DARK PAST
lines.zh: : 然后你就会来一句「我有一段黑暗的过去」

lines.en: : And I'd be all like I CAN FIX YOU
lines.zh: : 然后我就会来一句「我能治好你」

lines.en: : Then we'd bang or something idk
lines.zh: : 然后我们就睡了之类的,不知道

lines.en: : You should write a book.
lines.zh: : 你该去写本书。

lines.en: : And you should invent a time machine.
lines.zh: : 而你该去发明时光机。
